python_interfaces.name: DomainIdFactory
python_interfaces.contract: lowercase canonical UUIDv4 text; generated once; never derived from business/descriptive identifiers; all later domain LLDs reuse this convention unless accepted authority explicitly requires an external/business identity attribute in addition

python_interfaces.name: CustomerOrganizationRepository
python_interfaces.rule: no name-based identity API and no internal commit

python_interfaces.name: CustomerIdentifierRepository
python_interfaces.rule: Customer Account Code is external matching evidence; one Customer has at most one active code, but explicitly reviewed duplicate code may have multiple active Customer claimants and therefore remains ambiguous; superseded claims retain both creation and superseding command provenance; no internal commit

python_interfaces.name: CustomerAccountCodeReviewService
python_interfaces.rule: review_snapshot_hash is server-derived freshness/binding evidence over exact current conflict state; review_context_id is correlation/provenance only and never sufficient authorization

python_interfaces.name: ContactRepository
python_interfaces.rule: affiliation mutation preserves same contact_id, closes prior current row with closing-command provenance, and inserts the new current relationship rather than replacing identity

python_interfaces.name: ContactChannelRepository
python_interfaces.rule: channel values are reusable Contact data/matching evidence, never login identity; callers do not request an unbounded channel collection

python_interfaces.name: ContactChannelPolicy
python_interfaces.rule: Beta 1.0 EMAIL_CHANNEL_V1 follows algorithms/contact-channel.json; Contact may persist without any channel, and just-in-time recipient validation can block only the communication-dependent action

python_interfaces.name: DispatchLocationRepository
python_interfaces.rule: contains no Customer Organization ownership field and never owns Site rows

python_interfaces.name: ReferenceMatcher
python_interfaces.rule: pure query; returns UNRESOLVED, UNIQUE_CANDIDATE or AMBIGUOUS; Customer Account Code is preferred evidence but multiple reviewed claimants remain ambiguous; matcher never selects/merges/mutates

python_interfaces.name: ReferenceDependencyValidator
python_interfaces.rule: write-path guards query only indexed existence/eligibility facts in validator's owning domain using caller's UnitOfWork and never mutate/materialize unbounded rows; detailed blockers are read-only paginated queries outside writer lock

python_interfaces.name: ReferenceDependencyRegistry
python_interfaces.rule: composition-root code owns deterministic validator registration; runtime plugins/arbitrary dynamic imports are not accepted authority

python_interfaces.name: DispatchLocationService
python_interfaces.rule: no internal commit; LLD-08 Site coordinator uses create_dedicated_for_site inside one cross-domain UoW, then LLD-08 owns Site↔Dispatch Location relationship; service verifies the supplied typed/precomputed key belongs to the exact supplied name/profile before insert

python_interfaces.name: SiteDispatchAddressProvider
python_interfaces.rule: LLD-02 consumes derived Site context/address for display only; it never queries LLD-08 private tables directly

python_interfaces.name: SettingDefinitionRegistry
python_interfaces.rule: closed code-defined registry; unknown keys are rejected and do not become generic storage

python_interfaces.name: SettingStore
python_interfaces.rule: strict JSON validation delegates to LLD-01; reads never persist defaults

python_interfaces.name: LocalUserProfileIdentityStore
python_interfaces.rule: metadata identity only; verifier/password/auto-login remain LLD-12

candidate_result.rule: UNIQUE_CANDIDATE is proposal evidence, not authorization to merge/link; stable-code conflicts or multiple reviewed account-code claimants produce AMBIGUOUS rather than silent precedence

dependency_guard.rule: authoritative lifecycle eligibility uses complete set of registered bounded guards; indeterminate is fail-closed

dependency_page.rule: detailed blocker enumeration is read-only/paginated and never substitutes for transactional guard

repository_contract: all write methods receive LLD-01 UnitOfWork explicitly
static SQL and bound values only
repositories return LLD-02 value objects, not sqlite3.Row
cross-domain invariants use explicit interfaces rather than direct foreign-table access
enum/path values resolve through closed registries and are never concatenated into SQL identifiers
